$comment: The ONE source for every demo. The site's /demos/ page is generated from this at build time (scripts/demos.mjs), and the Discord #demos forum posts are generated from it by `npm run demos:discord` (aKnewMod intents). Edit here, never in Discord or HTML.

forum.title: Things we built by talking to AI.
forum.how: Tap a post, hit ▶️ **Play**. Works on your phone.
forum.byline: Prompted by Jack · A Knew Knowledge

demos.title: Maze Runner Online
demos.subtitle: play with friends
demos.lead: Pac-Man with friends: up to 4 players in 3D.
demos.how: Tap ▶️ Play Online, then hit **Share** and send the room link to a friend.

image.alt: Maze Runner Online: a smiling yellow Pac-Man with a name tag faces another player down a neon-edged corridor

demos.title: Maze Runner: Final
demos.subtitle: the polished build
demos.how: Tap ▶️ Play Final, then swipe or tap the big arrows. It rounds corners for you.

image.alt: Maze Runner: Final: a yellow Pac-Man with big eyes faces you in a glassy blue neon corridor, a glowing pellet on each side

demos.title: AFTERHOURS

demos.how: Tap ▶️ Play AFTERHOURS, then swipe or tap the arrows.
